detail.longDescription: Annoying situation. I went to Sci Foo Singapore (that bit was great!) and many people there wanted to collaborate with the RepRapMicron Project. However, on hearing that it wasn't backed by academia and thus couldn't get a grant proposal arranged, they backed off. Those looking at it from the startup perspective quickly realised that it had no current envisaged commercial application, but was close enough to endanger existing startups, and backed off. So # OpenSource it is.
